messages.subject: Lux metrics
parts:
Hello everyone,

I hope you're all doing well. I'm diving into GGIR for accelerometer data analysis and could really use your expertise. Specifically, I'm trying to extract lux data using GGIR with Actigraph Gt3x accelerometers. 
I've included my code for reference. Any guidance on how to move forward would be greatly appreciated!

Best regards!

---------------------
library(GGIR)
# General parameters
GGIR(datadir = "~/Desktop/GGIR/EyeFit/RAW/",
     outputdir = "~/Desktop/GGIR/EyeFit/OUTPUT/",
     studyname="EyeFit",
     desiredtz = "Chile/Continental",
     mode = (1:5),
     # Part 2 parameters
     strategy = 1,
     ndayswindow=7,
     hrs.del.start = 0,
     hrs.del.end = 0,
     maxdur = 7,
     qwindow=c(0, 24),
     windowsizes = c(5,900,3600),
     qlevels = c((24-2) /24, # MI20
                 (24-1)/24, #M60
                 (24-0.5) /24, #M30
                 (24-0.25) /24, #M15
                 (1440-5)/3440), #M05
     ilevels = c(0,50,100,200,8000),
     iglevels = 1,
     mvpathreshold =c(100.6),
     M5L5res = 10,
     # Part 3+4 parameters
     def.noc.sleep = 1,
     HASPT.algo ="HDZA",
     do.visual = TRUE,
     includenightcrit = 16,
     excludefirst.part4 = FALSE,
     excludelast.part4 = FALSE,
     # Part 5 parameters
     # Physical activity and inactivity threshold / Cut-points Hildebrand 2014; Hildebrand 2016
     do.enmo = TRUE,
     acc.metric = "ENMO",
     threshold.lig = c(44.8), threshold.mod = c(100.6),threshold.vig = c(428.8),
     # Bout durations
     boutdur.in = c(10,20,30), boutdur.lig = c(10), boutdur.mvpa = c(1, 5, 10),
     #Fraction of a bout that need to meet thresholds
     boutcriter = 0.8,
     boutcriter.in = 0.9, boutcriter.lig = 0.8, boutcriter.mvpa = 0.8,
     # Data cleaning
     includedaycrit.part5 = 2/3,
     # Report generation
     week_weekend_aggregate.part5 = FALSE, #Poner TRUE si necesito saber sobre solo la semana
     do.report=c(2,4,5))

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Lux metrics
parts:
Dear Juan,

GGIR uses the R package read.gt3x to read the gt3x data. Package read.gt3x does not extract lux data at the moment, by which GGIR can also not use it. So, read.gt3x will have to be updated to address your need.

The challenge however is that the original developers of read.gt3x do not have time anymore. Do you know someone who has time to do this? Or alternatively, do you know someone with funding to pay for someone else to do the work?

Best wishes,

Vincent

ndayswindow=7,

maxdur = 7,

(24-1)/24, #M60

def.noc.sleep = 1,
HASPT.algo ="HDZA",
do.visual = TRUE,
includenightcrit = 16,
excludefirst.part4 = FALSE,

# Part 5 parameters

boutcriter = 0.8,

includedaycrit.part5 = 2/3,
# Report generation
week_weekend_aggregate.part5 = FALSE, #Poner TRUE si necesito saber sobre solo la semana
do.report=c(2,4,5))
